Name: Daily Vocab TV Channel (SAT)
Author: GrumpyCar
Description:
The mod is usable with every TV and there's a new word every day! It only requires the Custom TV Channel mod (found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24278) and runs smoothly!
It requires no extra purchase or quest, is usable from day one and is alphabetically sorted!

(I now signed the mod up for Donation Points - which will all go to the Red Cross!)
